ZodValidationError.use: Schema validation failed against Zod schema

SchemaParseError.use: Schema structure is invalid or missing required fields
SchemaParseError.example: throw new SchemaParseError('Missing fields array in form schema')

FieldConfigError.use: Field configuration is invalid or references unknown type
FieldConfigError.example: throw new FieldConfigError('Unknown field type: rating')

PrimitivesContextError.use: Primitive component not registered in context
PrimitivesContextError.example: throw new PrimitivesContextError('No primitive registered for type: date')
